journey.name: Jade Sign On Device
journey.description: Declines and then approves a payment on the Jade emulator's own screens. Requires `JADE_MODE=interactive ./scripts/jade-emulator start` in `bitkit-docker`, a regtest debug build with the Jade emulator enabled (see the README), a paired Jade and funds on the Jade's regtest addresses. The device shows one Output screen per output and then Send Transaction with the fee, where X is selected; `./scripts/jade-emulator screen` saves what it shows.

actions.action: Launch the Bitkit app and go to the wallet home screen

Tap Send (testTag "Send"), enter a regtest address of the bitkit-docker node manually, select the Jade as the funding source on the amount screen (testTag "AssetButton-switch"), enter 50 000 sats and tap Continue (testTag "ContinueAmount")
Swipe to confirm and verify the hardware sign screen shows "Sign With Jade" (testTag "HardwareSendOpenTrezorConnect"), then tap it

If the device asks for its PIN, run `./scripts/jade-emulator pin 012345` in `bitkit-docker`. Run `./scripts/jade-emulator press front` to pass the Output screen, then `./scripts/jade-emulator press front` again to choose X on Send Transaction, and verify the app stays on the sign screen with no payment sent

Tap "Sign With Jade" again, run `./scripts/jade-emulator press front`, then `./scripts/jade-emulator press right front` to sign, and verify the success screen (testTag "SendSuccess") headed "Bitcoin Sent" appears within 30 seconds
